title: tests/schc_failure_tracker: Zephyr branch unbuildable + no testcase.yaml (twister discovery hole)
description: Edge-cases review of b7z9.92 commit c930e39a8f (2026-09-09) found two defects in lichen/tests/schc_failure_tracker/: (1) CMakeLists.txt:16-17 Zephyr branch (ZEPHYR_BASE set) adds only src/main.c to app and relies on the CONFIG_LICHEN_SCHC-gated library for both the include path (schc/CMakeLists.txt:22 zephyr_include_directories) and tracker symbols, but the test dir ships NO prj.conf so CONFIG_LICHEN_SCHC is unset: main.c:8 fails on #include <lichen/schc_failure_tracker.h> and lichen_schc_failure_* would be undefined at link. Every other dual-mode test pairs this structure with a prj.conf enabling the gating CONFIG (e.g. redundant_slot/prj.conf sets CONFIG_LICHEN_HAL=y) or compiles the source into app directly (coap_codec/CMakeLists.txt:32). (2) No testcase.yaml: survey of all ~150 lichen/tests/* dirs shows every test with a Zephyr branch has both testcase.yaml + prj.conf; schc_failure_tracker is the sole exception, so twister can never discover it and defect (1) can never be caught by CI. Fix: add prj.conf (CONFIG_LICHEN=y, CONFIG_LICHEN_SCHC=y) + testcase.yaml mirroring schc_generic (platform_allow native_sim, sanitizers.conf), or delete the Zephyr half and keep the test host-only.
